blocks.raw:

blocks.raw: ### 2.2 FINRA 3210 - Duplicate Compliance reports
blocks.text: 2.2 FINRA 3210 - Duplicate Compliance reports

blocks.raw: #### Existing Feature - Some of our partners require information about trading activity to report to  for regulatory compliance. Presently there is a manual list of accounts maintained by DriveWealth's compliance team that is populated with this information on a daily basis. This data is then sent to the partner or their vendors via SFTP.
blocks.text: Existing Feature - Some of our partners require information about trading activity to report to  for regulatory compliance. Presently there is a manual list of accounts maintained by DriveWealth's compliance team that is populated with this information on a daily basis. This data is then sent to the partner or their vendors via SFTP.

blocks.raw: #### What is improving? - We are attempting to semi-automate this manual process so it can be used programmatically by the partner to retrieve reports for 3210 reporting.
blocks.text: What is improving? - We are attempting to semi-automate this manual process so it can be used programmatically by the partner to retrieve reports for 3210 reporting.

blocks.raw: #### Available to Test in UAT  - Yes
blocks.text: Available to Test in UAT  - Yes

blocks.text: Feature Toggle (Y/N) - No

blocks.raw: A two step solution is being proposed to identify accounts and group them into the vendor to which the trading data needs to be sent. This data will be semi-customizable, where a partner will be allowed a pre-approved list of vendors they can request to group together.
blocks.text: A two step solution is being proposed to identify accounts and group them into the vendor to which the trading data needs to be sent. This data will be semi-customizable, where a partner will be allowed a pre-approved list of vendors they can request to group together.

blocks.raw: The two step process is as follows:
blocks.text: The two step process is as follows:

blocks.raw: **Step 1: Add the compliance reporting vendor/employer on the customer’s DW account.  (ComplySci, MCO, etc.)**
blocks.text: Step 1: Add the compliance reporting vendor/employer on the customer’s DW account.  (ComplySci, MCO, etc.)

blocks.raw: A new account field **finra3210ComplianceEntity** is being introduced which can be added on an account via a POST or a PATCH request. This field is optional.
blocks.text: A new account field finra3210ComplianceEntity is being introduced which can be added on an account via a POST or a PATCH request. This field is optional.

blocks.raw:
```Text Add Compliance Entity to account
POST /accounts

Request Body:
{
  "userID": "cc07f91b-7ee1-4868-b8fc-823c70a1b932",
  "accountType": "LIVE",
  "accountManagementType": "SELF",
  "tradingType": "CASH",
  ...
  "finra3210ComplianceEntity": "COMPLYSCI",
  ...
}
```
```Text PATCH
PATCH /accounts/accountID

Request Body:
{
  "finra3210ComplianceEntity": "COMPLYSCI"
}
```
```Text Delete Compliance Vendor from account
PATCH /accounts/accountID

Request Body:
{
  "finra3210ComplianceEntity": ""
}

Note: Field needs to be passed as empty
```

blocks.raw: # 3. 🔧Bug Fixes
blocks.text: 3. 🔧Bug Fixes

blocks.raw: #### What is the bug? - In the CREATE USER endpoint, when the ID Type  = FTNL0 is selected as the Identification Info, the value field should remain OPTIONAL.
blocks.text: What is the bug? - In the CREATE USER endpoint, when the ID Type  = FTNL0 is selected as the Identification Info, the value field should remain OPTIONAL.

blocks.raw: However, we discovered a bug in UAT the value field is REQUIRED.
blocks.text: However, we discovered a bug in UAT the value field is REQUIRED.

blocks.raw: #### The Fix - When passing Identification Info as ID Type = FTNL0, our partners will not be required to enter any value or numbers. This field can be left blank and will remain optional.
